Inspect and modify bronto configuration

```sh
bronto config <command> [flags]
```

#### Subcommands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`bronto config get`](/reference/commands/config/#bronto-config-get) | Print a single resolved config value |
| [`bronto config list`](/reference/commands/config/#bronto-config-list) | Show all resolved config values and where each came from |
| [`bronto config set`](/reference/commands/config/#bronto-config-set) | Persist a config value in the user config file |

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto config get

Print a single resolved config value

```sh
bronto config get <key> [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto config list

Show all resolved config values and where each came from

```sh
bronto config list [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).

## bronto config set

Persist a config value in the user config file

```sh
bronto config set <key> <value> [flags]
```

Also accepts the [global flags](/reference/commands/global-flags/).
